title: Elevator Requests IV
summary: An elevator starts at floor start at time zero. Each second it may move one floor up/down or wait. A request [arrival,floor] completes instantly whenever the elevator occupies that floor at or after arrival. Requests need not be served in input order. Return the earliest time by which all requests can be completed.
